home.about.title: About Muntrume Motorsport (MMT)
home.about.body: Muntrume Motorsport (MMT) is an iRacing team based in Sant Andreu, Barcelona. It publishes its drivers' profiles, keeps the .sto setups in the Garage and shares telemetry on Garage 61. Team radio is on Discord.

paddock.rules.title: Code of conduct and track protocol
paddock.rules.1.title: #01 · Safety first
paddock.rules.1.body: Aim for a low incident count (0x–4x) to protect the team's Class A licence and safety rating.
paddock.rules.2.title: #02 · Open telemetry
paddock.rules.2.body: Active Garage 61 sync in every official session so sector deltas can be compared.
paddock.rules.3.title: #03 · Radio discipline
paddock.rules.3.body: A clean Discord channel, with push-to-talk required in qualifying and pit stops.
paddock.rules.4.title: #04 · Sporting respect
paddock.rules.4.body: No toxicity. Safe rejoins and space for cars being lapped in multiclass.

app.title: MMT Sync
app.lead: The official Muntrume Motorsport desktop app. It syncs race, qualifying and wet setups into your iRacing folders and shows live pedal, steering, gear and speed bars on track.
app.safe.title: Checked by the team
app.safe.sub: No ads · no third-party trackers · it does not change your private files
app.safe.sdk.title: Read-only iRacing SDK
app.safe.sdk.body: MMT Sync connects to iRacing in read-only mode (FILE_MAP_READ) through the simulator's official shared memory. It does not write into the game.
app.safe.screen.title: Windows SmartScreen notice
app.safe.screen.body: This is a private team tool without a commercial Microsoft certificate, so Windows may say it protected your PC. To install, choose More info and then Run anyway.
app.cap.1.title: Automatic sync
app.cap.1.body: Downloads the team's official setups in one click, organised under setups\car\MMT\season. Your own setups stay where they are.
app.cap.2.title: Live telemetry
app.cap.2.body: Detects the iRacing session on track and shows live bars for throttle, brake, steering angle, gear and speed.
app.cap.3.title: Calculator and strategy
app.cap.3.body: Estimates the fuel for an endurance race, the pit stops and a pre-race checklist.
app.how.title: Link the app in three steps
app.how.1.title: Install and open MMT Sync
app.how.1.body: Run the installer and press Link with muntru.me. You will see an 8-character code.
app.how.2.title: Approve it on the site
app.how.2.body: Your browser opens muntru.me. Press Authorise this device while your driver session is active.
app.how.3.title: Ready to drive
app.how.3.body: The token is stored in Windows Credential Manager. Press Sync now to put the setups in iRacing.
